title: Heartfelt Note
message:
Happy birthday my sweet boy 😚
This 25th birthday marks a milestone. I hope you are proud of yourself today. you deserve to be. 
I hope this year brings you all the love, happiness and everything you deserve and more.

Nothing comes to mind when I try to sit down and write your birthday letter except for thank you. Thank you for staying with me through everything, for your never ending patience, for all your understanding, for all your encouragement and advice. 

I love that you are one of the biggest parts of my life now. I love making memories with you, I love eating with you, I love working out with you, I love doing music with you, I love doing trips with you and I hope we get to do it forever.

Nothing compares to the coffee/chai (but mostly coffee) runs we go on. I thought this deserved it's own paragraph because it really does become the highlight of my day. 

They say everything is better when you get to share it with someone. And it really is better when I get to share my life with you. 

I believe in trying to make an impact on everyone you meet, a good impact at that - which you have done for me. You make me want to be a better person everyday, strive to work hard and try to become the best person I can be. I think that kind of a person is worth keeping around - and I want to do exactly that. 

Here is to a lifetime of Umesh, Benne (all masala dosa actually) soya chaap hunting, CONCERTS AND TRIPS, music and driving, cooking and eating, wallpapers, funny socks and blanket stealing. 

I love you 🫶🏼
